_doc: 美术资产清单 = 唯一真相源。tools/art_audit.gd 据此列出缺失资产并生成提示词；tools/import_art.gd 据此把 art_inbox/ 里的图片处理成游戏资产。新增基因部件/骨架/生态区/状态/卡牌时必须在这里补规格，test_data 会检查。mode: palette=灰度绘制+运行时按种族上色（饱和色区域=发光强调色）；mono=白色剪影图标（运行时着色）；color=保留原色；cutout=保留原色但去背景。

style.part: 2D game asset for a creature-assembly game, dark biological fantasy, dark naturalist illustration style, a single isolated creature part shown on its own, not attached to any body, side view facing right, monochrome grayscale value painting, flat cel shading with one soft highlight, thick closed uniform near-black outline around the whole shape, clean readable silhouette, centered and filling most of the frame with a small margin, plain flat pure white background, no ground, no cast shadow, no text, no labels
style.body: 2D game asset for a creature-assembly game, dark biological fantasy, dark naturalist illustration style, full body of a creature in its plain base form, side view facing right, neutral idle pose, monochrome grayscale value painting, flat cel shading with one soft highlight, thick closed uniform near-black outline around the whole silhouette, whole body visible and filling most of the frame with a small margin, the lowest point of the body near the bottom edge, no weapons, no accessories, no extra organs, plain flat pure white background, no ground, no cast shadow, no text, no labels
style.icon: flat game UI icon, one bold simple solid white silhouette symbol, centered, chunky shapes readable at 32 pixels, plain flat pure black background, no circle or rounded-square tile behind the symbol, no glow, no gradient, no border, no text
style.background: 2D side-view game battle background, dark biological fantasy, painterly, muted desaturated colors, horizon in the upper third, wide calm flat ground band across the middle and lower half where creatures will stand, darker and low-contrast in the center, atmospheric depth, no characters, no creatures, no text, no UI, no border
style.illustration: dark biological fantasy illustration, ink outlines with painterly color, muted earthy tones with bioluminescent accents, readable silhouette, no text, no handwriting, no page or paper border, no watermark
style.ui: dark biological fantasy game UI element, aged parchment, bone and dark chitin, ink line details, flat front view, no text
style.negative: photo, photorealistic, 3d render, gore, blood splatter, text, letters, labels, handwriting, watermark, signature, logo, multiple objects, extra creature, hands, scene, background details, ground, cast shadow, frame, border, cropped, blurry, low contrast outline
style.negative_color_ok: photo, photorealistic, 3d render, gore, text, letters, handwriting, watermark, signature, logo, card frame, border, blurry
style.accent_clause: Only {accent} glow in a bright saturated green; everything else stays strictly grayscale.
style.no_accent_clause: No glowing or colored areas at all; strictly grayscale.
style.style_cn: 见《美术资产清单与提示词.txt》第四节：按类别选用的中文风格锁定
